activation: No imports from runtime, no device opening, no service installation and no default keys.
scope: Explicitly provisioned pairwise sessions for bounded synthetic/public bench transfers; ordinary SAGE/HTTPS authentication is not bypassed.
bootstrap: Each endpoint receives the exact full peer identities, one fresh session/incarnation, route/profile binding digest, fixed expiry, limits and an independent secret through pinned management. Unknown sessions and versions are refused. No remote peer can enroll itself or choose a grant.

wire.authentication: ChaCha20-Poly1305, 96-bit nonce = zero32 || monotonic_counter64. HKDF-SHA256 derives separate direction keys from the pairwise secret, session incarnation and complete canonical grant. AAD binds domain, complete grant digest and exact header.
wire.compact_identity: On-air session ID only selects an already provisioned full chain-qualified identity binding. It conveys no independent authority.
wire.reliability: Outer nonce/replay counter is independent of the inner reliable-flow sequence. Each retry is newly sealed. Replay admission does not establish application consumption, SAGE commit or human read.

persistence.nonce: Commit the next counter with SQLite synchronous=FULL before encrypting or returning bytes; abandoned reservations remain spent.
persistence.receive: Authenticate before advancing the durable 256-packet replay window; commit admission before returning plaintext. A crash before inner delivery is recovered by an inner-flow retry with a fresh outer counter.
persistence.restart: Reopen requires original grant, endpoint, boot and original absolute epoch/monotonic expiry. Missing state never implicitly creates a new session. Reboot or retirement requires fresh provisioning; durable object resume is a separate layer.
persistence.authority: Caller-provided live authority is checked at reservation/admission and again after decryption. Actual service/broker worker grant integration remains open.
persistence.storage: Metadata only in an owner-private directory and regular single-link 0600 file. Secret and payload are not written. Deployment must protect state from deletion/rollback; ordinary SQLite is not hardware rollback protection.

required_next: Independent adversarial source review and exact focused test evidence
Provisioning/retirement adapter that creates unique run keys and protects state without private SAGE access

Integration with accepted flow scheduler and durable verified object resume
